top_signals.title: Stocks Rise in Runup to Nvidia, Oil Extends Slide: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks rose as Asian semiconductor makers advanced ahead of Nvidia Corp.’s results, with traders looking to the chip bellwether’s earnings for the next beat in the artificial intelligence trade. Oil extended its decline.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
